verdict.rationale: Per-tier concurrency limits and the cost of raising them are a fair question for a cloud scraping platform like Apify, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents concurrent-run or request caps per plan, or any price for raising them. SessionPool is an SDK class for rotating proxies and cookies, not a pricing-tier limit, and the community praise of the pricing page says nothing about limits.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I know the maximum concurrent sessions or requests allowed on my pricing tier and the cost to raise that cap
